description: Take, change or give up the current user's handle: the name other players type ("@name") to find the wantlists and tradelists this user has PUBLISHED with create_share_link. 3–20 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". handle null gives it up. Tell the user what a handle exposes: anyone who knows it — signed in or not, at /@name — sees every wantlist and tradelist link that is not revoked, never a deck share, the collection, a name or an email. Revoking a link removes it from the handle at once. Giving up the handle also leaves the trade circle: every friend and request goes. Changing it keeps the circle.

handle.description: The handle to take, with or without the @; null to give it up

name: set_handle
title: Set handle
